function: A clickable button is marked up as follows.

attributes.name: autofocus
attributes.function: Specifies that a button should automatically get focus when the page loads

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.function: Specifies that a button should be disabled

attributes.name: command
attributes.values: show-modal | close | request-close | show-popover | hide-popover | toggle-popover | --custom-value
attributes.function: Specifies the action to be performed

attributes.name: commandfor
attributes.function: Turns the button into a command button

attributes.name: form
attributes.function: Specifies which form the button belongs to

attributes.name: formaction
attributes.function: Specifies where to send the form-data when a form is submitted. Only for type="submit"

attributes.name: formenctype
attributes.function: Specifies how form-data should be encoded before sending it to a server. Only for type="submit"

attributes.name: formmethod
attributes.function: Specifies how to send the form-data (which HTTP method to use). Only for type="submit"

attributes.name: formnovalidate
attributes.function: Specifies that the form-data should not be validated on submission. Only for type="submit"

attributes.name: formtarget
attributes.function: Specifies where to display the response after submitting the form. Only for type="submit"

attributes.name: name
attributes.function: Specifies a name for the button

attributes.name: popovertarget
attributes.function: Specifies which popover element to invoke

attributes.name: popovertargetaction
attributes.function: Specifies what happens to the targeted popover element when you click the button

attributes.name: value
attributes.function: Specifies an initial value for the button
